supplementaryChecks.scope: Existing unchanged Windows server test issues: two open-handle cleanup EPERM failures, one POSIX mode assertion. Reproduced and not relaxed; excluded from course pass count.

fixes.issue: Three simultaneous blanks and inherited grammar questions without short models
fixes.resolution: Redistribute six original judgement slots into three related two-blank questions; keep targets; add visibly recorded models.

fixes.issue: Cross-device account test required local Snapshot although remote Progress held all 65 records
fixes.resolution: Read the actual supported history source and assert all 65 records plus visible history. No product mutation for the test.

fixes.issue: Server chose the first legacy group with matching IDs instead of the valid newer five-star round
fixes.resolution: Scope preferred session lookup to Lesson19 with rewards; validate same round and preserve earlier fallback. Four original run IDs/states and both award dates retained.

reuseBoundary: Prior v3.0 source/target review and unchanged artwork remain applicable. Current full course and 65-to-66 account flow rerun in both engines at both mounts; authorization, resource failure, long name, one-star export and direct 36-to-current paths rerun in Chromium root and WebKit subpath. Other matrix cells for those unchanged shared capabilities reuse v3.0 evidence and do not add to current count. Public page runs are unaffected by the later server-only round-selection fix; all final account checks use the fix.
checkScope: Scoped course development verification. check:plan covered cumulative workspace changes, not just this turn. Full-repository and release checks not claimed.
